# GH-300 Study Planner Source Pack

Use these references to ensure plans are objective-driven, voice-consistent, and exam aligned.

## Local source files

- `working-temp/converted/style-guide.from-pdf.md` (MarkItDown output from style-guide.pdf)
- `working-temp/mwsg-rules 2.md` (voice and syntax guidance)
- `working-temp/wwl-exam-rules.md` (exam-safe writing constraints)
- `references/gh300-objectives.md` (January 2026 objectives and weight ranges)

## Planner defaults

- Cover all six GH-300 skill areas.
- Prioritize weak or unknown areas first.
- Use weight ranges, not fixed percentages.
- Keep recommendations practical and time-bounded.
